Mienshao

Fighting

Unova · Generation 5

Mienshao is a Fighting-type Martial Arts Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 35.5 kg. It evolves from Mienfoo. Its highest base stat is Attack (125), with a base stat total of 510.
